subject: [video] WP04/WP03 interface conflict: qp 0 is normalised to 26 before rc_open, so the bpp first-QP table is dead
body: WP03's avc/n2avc_enc.c:294 does 'e->cfg.qp = cfg->qp ? cfg->qp : 26;' and :342 calls 'n2avc_rc_open(&e->cfg)'. My task says 'first QP from bits-per-pixel (table in the source)' when bitrate != 0 and the caller leaves qp 0; n2avc.h says 'with a bitrate: the first picture's QP (0 -> 26)'. As it stands the rate controller only ever sees 26. Two clean fixes, lead's choice: (a) WP03 passes the raw cfg->qp (0 allowed) to n2avc_rc_open and only normalises for constant-QP mode; (b) I treat cfg->qp == 26 with bitrate != 0 as 'unset' and use the bpp table (but then an explicit 26 cannot be expressed as the first QP). I prefer (a); it needs a one-line change in WP03's file, which I must not edit. Until ruled, my controller uses cfg->qp when it is 10..51 and the bpp table only when it is 0; the closed-loop test still converges (1 Mbit/s 640x480 -> 247k bytes) but starts at 26 instead of the table's 33. Integration of the real encoder is starting now; I will report bit-exactness and the measured sizes.
